targets.outcome_robustness_quote: Panel D, which reports the main IV results, also changed after correcting for robust standard errors: Column 1 estimates are significant at the 10% level instead of 5% level and columns 4 and 5 are no longer significant. targets.outcome_reasoning: Original-data reanalysis. Correcting standard errors removes significance for IV findings, qualifying robustness although the main difference-in-differences result survives.
